label: ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2
definition: Providers of high-risk AI systems must ensure their systems comply with Section 2 requirements.
source_quote: ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2

label: indicate on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, as applicable, their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, the address at which they can be contacted
definition: Providers must indicate their name, trade name, trademark, and contact address on the system or packaging.
source_quote: indicate on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, as applicable, their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, the address at which they can be contacted

label: have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17
definition: Providers must have a quality management system that complies with Article 17.
source_quote: have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17

label: keep the documentation referred to in Article 18
definition: Providers must keep the documentation referred to in Article 18.
source_quote: keep the documentation referred to in Article 18

label: when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as referred to in Article 19
definition: Providers must keep logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems when under their control.
source_quote: when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as referred to in Article 19

label: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43, prior to its being placed on the market or put into service
definition: Providers must ensure their high-risk AI systems undergo a conformity assessment procedure before placement.
source_quote: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43, prior to its being placed on the market or put into service

term: Draw up EU Declaration of Conformity
label: draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47
definition: Providers must draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47.
source_quote: draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47

label: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, to indicate conformity with this Regulation, in accordance with Article 48
definition: Providers must affix the CE marking to the system or packaging to indicate conformity.
source_quote: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, to indicate conformity with this Regulation, in accordance with Article 48

label: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1)
definition: Providers must comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1).
source_quote: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1)

label: take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20
definition: Providers must take necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20.
source_quote: take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20

label: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2
definition: Providers must demonstrate conformity upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority.
source_quote: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2

label: ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882
definition: Providers must ensure their high-risk AI systems comply with accessibility requirements in accordance with specific EU Directives.
source_quote: ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882
